subject.title: fix(searxng): fail closed on unresolved base url refs

question: Should an explicitly configured but unavailable or malformed SearXNG `baseUrl` fail closed, even though existing setups may currently continue through `SEARXNG_BASE_URL`?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound and prevents silent endpoint substitution, but it deliberately removes a fallback that some existing configurations may rely on; code inspection cannot determine whether maintainers accept that upgrade behavior.

options.title: Accept fail-closed routing
options.body: Land the PR so explicit SearXNG targets never silently route through an unrelated ambient endpoint when resolution fails.

options.title: Preserve compatibility
options.body: Keep ambient fallback as the default and require a separately approved strict-mode product design if fail-closed behavior is desired.

options.title: Decline the behavior change
options.body: Close the PR and retain the current fallback contract if continuity is considered more important than explicit-target isolation.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed routing
recommendation.body: Land the PR so explicit SearXNG targets never silently route through an unrelated ambient endpoint when resolution fails.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc contributed and merged the original SearXNG implementation, giving the strongest available history signal for deciding its fallback contract.
